definitions.explanation: Unable or unwilling to accept views, behaviors, or people different from one's own; lacking generosity of spirit. Describes a person's disposition or an institution's attitude, often in critical or reflective writing. More formal and literary than {心|こころ}が{狭|せま}い, which is the everyday equivalent.

examples.japanese: {狭量|きょうりょう}な⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{狭量|きょうりょう}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦うんざりした→うんざりする：20665_unzarisuru⟧。
examples.english: I was fed up with his small-minded attitude.

examples.japanese: ⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一切|いっさい}→一切：06662_issai⟧⟦{認|みと}めない→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{狭量|きょうりょう}⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧ものだ。
examples.english: Refusing to accept any differing opinion is simply narrow-mindedness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{多様性|たようせい}→多様性：04825_tayousei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れられない→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧{狭量|きょうりょう}な⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{通用|つうよう}→通用：04530_tsuuyou⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A narrow-minded stance that cannot accept social diversity will not be accepted in the international community.

notes:
Compound of {狭|きょう} ('narrow') and ⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧ ('capacity; measure'), literally 'narrow capacity' — i.e., small capacity of mind. A formal, bookish adjective that conveys a measured, critical judgment of character.

USAGE:
- Almost always used as a na-adjective before nouns describing people or their attitudes: {狭量|きょうりょう}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧, {狭量|きょうりょう}な⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧, {狭量|きょうりょう}な⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧.
- Used as a predicate noun to name the quality itself: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{狭量|きょうりょう}だ ('that's narrow-mindedness').
- Rare in casual conversation; belongs to essays, editorials, and thoughtful criticism.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {狭量|きょうりょう}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a narrow-minded person
- {狭量|きょうりょう}な⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧: narrow-minded thinking
- {狭量|きょうりょう}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: a petty attitude
- {狭量|きょうりょう}な⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧: a small-minded politician
- {狭量|きょうりょう}さ: narrow-mindedness (the noun form via さ)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{心|こころ}が{狭|せま}い→心が狭い：25593_kokorogasemai⟧: narrow-hearted; petty — the everyday equivalent; less formal.
- {偏狭|へんきょう}: parochial; bigoted — stronger, implies prejudice and rigidity, not just pettiness.
- ⟦{度量|どりょう}→度量：21413_doryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧: small-minded — idiom with ⟦{度量|どりょう}→度量：21413_doryou⟧ ('tolerance; magnanimity').
- ⟦{寛容|かんよう}→寛容：10888_kanyou⟧: tolerant — direct antonym.
- ⟦{寛容|かんよう}→寛容：10888_kanyou⟧: tolerant; broad-minded
- ⟦{度量|どりょう}→度量：21413_doryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧: magnanimous; big-hearted
